description: This Java source file defines the EntityEcaUtil class, which provides utility methods for managing Entity Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionality for loading ECA rules from configuration files, caching, and retrieving rules based on entity and event names.

classes.name: EntityEcaUtil
classes.description: A final utility class that provides methods for loading, caching, and retrieving Entity ECA rules in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getEntityEcaCache
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the ECA rules cache for a given entity ECA reader name, reading configuration if not already cached.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReaderName
methods.description: Gets the name of the entity ECA reader associated with a given delegator name.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from resource files and component configurations, populating the provided cache map.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses a resource handler's XML document to extract ECA rules.

methods.name: createEcaLoaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a callable for asynchronously loading ECA rules from a resource handler.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of ECA rules for a specific entity and event from the cache.
